title: Contrix Applet Protocol Object
description: Schema-registry object for applet protocol metadata snapshots. Event payloads for cx.applet.* MUST use the typed payload definitions in event-payload.schema.json; this object is not a loose transport envelope and is closed at the top level except for x_* extensions.

applet_id.description: Stable applet identifier. MUST be either a DID or the registered typed-id form cx:applet:<uuidv7>. Arbitrary opaque strings are not valid wire identifiers; bridge-specific aliases belong in namespace / external_ref fields.

service_did.description: DID of the service that hosts the applet runtime (used by registration / discovery).

session_id.description: Per-invocation correlation id used by protocol_session.start / .status to pair request/response.

params.description: Caller-supplied parameters for protocol_session.start. Opaque to soland — bridge implementations interpret per applet manifest.

detail.description: Bridge-side detail surface (echo response payload, error context, bridge identifier, etc.). Free-form object; bridges document their own schema.

manifest.description: Applet manifest snapshot at registration time (capability requirements, supported intents, etc.).
